name: Maps
description: Windows MDM settings in the Maps category, applied as OMA-URI (SyncML) values.

properties.name: Allow Offline Maps Download Over Metered Connection
properties.description: Allows the download and update of map data over metered connections. After the policy is applied, you can verify the settings in the user interface in System > Offline Maps.

enum.description: Disabled. Force disable auto-update over metered connection.
Enabled. Force enable auto-update over metered connection.

properties.name: Enable Offline Maps Auto Update
properties.description: Disables the automatic download and update of map data. After the policy is applied, you can verify the settings in the user interface in System > Offline Maps.
